# profiles

Public product profiles and their parameters; use applicability fields to identify the relevant product.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="profiles", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="profiles", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activation_minutes` | integer | Top-level filter | Activation minutes: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `channel` | string | Top-level filter | Channel: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `EUR`, `GBP`, `SGD`, `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `daily_limit_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Daily limit amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `effective_date` | string | Top-level filter | Effective date: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `evidence_valid_minutes` | integer | Top-level filter | Evidence valid minutes: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `fee_bp` | integer | Top-level filter | Fee rate in basis points: 100 bp = 1%, 10,000 bp = 100%. The product rule specifies the amount to which the rate applies. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `minimum_fee_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Minimum fee amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `minimum_payment_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Minimum payment amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `original_return_supported` | boolean | Top-level filter | Original return supported: true/false state flag for this record. |
| `platform` | string | Top-level filter | Platform: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `previous_fee_bp` | integer | Top-level filter | Previous fee rate in basis points: 100 bp = 1%, 10,000 bp = 100%. The product rule specifies the amount to which the rate applies. |
| `product_name` | string | Top-level filter | Product name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `quota_method` | string | Top-level filter | Quota method: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `quota_valid_minutes` | integer | Top-level filter | Quota valid minutes: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `region` | string | Top-level filter | Region: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `settlement_minutes` | integer | Top-level filter | Settlement minutes: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `source` | string | Top-level filter | Source: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `version` | integer | Top-level filter | Version of the underlying record or evidence, not the benchmark release version. |
